title: The Inheritance of Bellwether Lane
author: Ivo Zhou
blurb: Casper Almeida, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
